shot.action: Cozy bedroom with Zuri, Kofi, and Nala sleeping
shot.setting: a cozy bedroom with a star-patterned blanket, a shelf of plush toys, a small night lamp and a crescent-moon wall decal

cast_text: Three adorable Black toddlers: Kofi, a 4-year-old boy with medium-deep brown skin, short dark natural curly hair, wearing a blue t-shirt, grey jogger shorts and red sneakers; Nala, a 3-year-old girl with deep brown skin, neat cornrow braids, wearing a yellow pinafore dress over a white t-shirt, white tights and pink sneakers; and Zuri, a 3-year-old girl with deep warm brown skin, round afro puffs tied with soft yellow fabric scrunchies, wearing a sunny yellow t-shirt, denim dungaree shorts and white sneakers
